'''Gilad Halsek''' was the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Consul-General]] on [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]].

==Biography==
Gilad was a minor official on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. During his service he earned several enemies. Being paranoid about his safety, he pulled some strings in [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucracy]] to be transferred. He chose the "dismal" position on Kothlis, which however was safe and comfortable for him and his petty ambitions.<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>

During his time on Kothlis, he kept a low profile, hoping he would remain invisible from his rivals. He occasionally turned a blind eye to the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]], ensuring that the populace would not turn against him. Thanks to ruling [[clan Balya]]'s ties to the Empire, it was ensured that the Imperial rule was benign. When he was seen in [[Tal'cara]], he was accompanied by a [[squad/Legends|squad]] of 4 [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtrooper]]s from the [[Imperial compound (Kothlis)|compound]], ostentatiously wearing his ornate sporting [[blaster/Legends|blaster]]. Although in his capacity he was overseeing the [[Bothan Colonial Board]], he mostly abstained from the votes. He spent most of his time collecting and manipulating financial or bureaucratic data from the council.<ref name="guide" />

Upset with the lack of Imperial troop support, Gilad hired a temporary band of mercenaries known as [[Beldonna's League]] to bolster the planet's defense. He paid the unit from the Bothan treasury and provided barracks and support facilities for their needs. He also fell in love with the leader of the mercenaries, [[Liiria Beldonna]]. He also sometimes employed the services of [[Rathleek]]'s [[Rathleek's hunting band|band]] of [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] [[hunting/Legends|hunters]].<ref name="guide" />

He was approached by [[Cecil Noone]] around [[0 BBY/Legends|0 ABY]] when the thief was attempting to offload a stolen [[Hapan]] [[Gun of Command]]. Halsek double-crossed the thief however, and Noone and his crew just managed to escape from the planet ahead of 24 [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and a legion of planetary militia.
==Personality and traits==
Halsek had pale baggy skin. He kept his hair short and always neatly combed. At his 42 years, it was prematurely grey. He was always seen in his [[Imperial officer's uniform/Legends|official uniform]], with an ornate blaster worn at his side.<ref name="guide" /> 

Halsek operated not only according to his complete loyalty to the Empire, but also his comfort and safety. Through his neat, disciplined appearance and demeanor, his kept a calculated authority, prioritizing the stability of his position. He was outspoken and stubborn in his views, often asserting them with confidence, yet beneath this lay a petty, sneaky personality, with a strong instinct for self-preservation.<ref name="guide" />
